p99_evidence_lines.text:
'''NOTE: THIS QUEST REQUIRES WARMLY FACTION WITH CAMLEND SERBOLD TO DO TURN IN.
IF YOU ARE NOT WARMLY FACTION YOU WILL LOSE YOUR ITEMS. DON'T WASTE HOURS OF CAMPING.

''Notes on faction: Do not despair! Acquiring the appropriate faction is easy and straightforward! If by the end of camping Grimrot you haven't hit warmly by killing the putrid skellies, there is a simple quest to do. Turn in 2g at a time to [[Lashun Novashine]] in the Qeynos newbie yard. It took me 450 turn-ins to go from apprehensive to warmly, but as long as you aren't KOS it is possible. The 450 turn-ins took maybe an hour to do... Just grab 1000 gold and it should be enough.
''"It took my Dwarf Cleric 1750 gold (approximately 875 turn ins) to go from Apprehensive to Warmly." "2274 gold to get from dubious to warmly on my Human Innoruuk Cleric".
This quest begins with [[Capt Linarius]] in North Karana (on the bridge to South Karana). He asks you to speak with Camlend Serbold in [[Qeynos]].
Go to [[Southern Karana]]. Not far from the end of the bridge is an undead camp. [[Lord Grimrot]]'s placeholder is the only putrid skeleton that is standing.
The live version drops two Pestilence Scythes. The {{:Pestilence Scythe}} with the proc is the one you need to turn-in. The undead version drops the {{:Decaying Heart}}.
Turn in both the Scythe and the Heart to [[Camlend Serbold]] to receive the {{:Aegis of Life}}.
You Can turn in both the [[Decaying Heart]] and [[Pestilence Scythe]] at the same time.

: [[Capt Linarius]] says 'Hail, traveler! You are free to rest within this keep or within any of my towers along the roads to Qeynos. My guards shall keep watch over you. While you tread upon the roads, be warned that there are '''[local dangers]''' as well as rumors of [corrupt guards].'
''Do as Linarius says, and journey to '''[[Qeynos]]'''. Camlend is inside the priest guild in North Qeynos.''

: [[Camlend Serbold]] says 'I say, good to meet you, Sephira! I am Camlend Serbold. Some call me Serbold the Great. I am the leader of the righteous order of paladins which serves the Temple of Life. Together with the clerics of this temple, we defend the will of the great '''[Rodcet Nife]''' and smite all who dare to oppose us.'

''Note: If Camlend responds with 'The Temple Smiles Upon you, friend... but such a delicate matter can only be entrusted to our most loyal members' -- Then you do not have the required faction for turn in. He must have the dialogue below.

: Camlend Serbold says 'Then go to the Plains of Karana. Somewhere there, Lord Grimrot is hatching his little plan for the Bloodsabers. Bring me his evil scythe and his heart. It is said that upon his death, his soul will be absorbed into this weapon of darkness. Do this and be rewarded.'

p99_evidence_lines.text: [[File:roarmor2.jpg|frame|Complete Armor of Ro set.  Unlike Lord Searfire, the gauntlets and boots on players show the bronze armor graphic.]]

The Armor of Ro is a set of [[Paladin]] specific armor quested from [[The Temple of Solusek Ro]] and the paladins encamped in [[Rathe Mountains]].  '''Each piece of the Armor of Ro is created by combining a quested Mold of Ro and a crafted [[A Bar of Ronium|Bar of Ronium]] in a NON-CULTURAL forge'''.  The molds are NO DROP but the Bar of Ronium is tradeable, as are the completed armor pieces.  The armor is only usable by paladins, but can be quested by any character able to get their faction with the quest NPCs to Amiable.  Each mold requires Amiable with a separate faction.

To get the molds, you must go to the [[Rathe Mountains]] paladin camp (+2930, -800). Each mold must be quested from a different NPC in the camp, and each NPC is on a different faction. If the NPC does not con at least Amiable to you, he or she will refer you to their guild instead of giving you the quest.
You must have Amiable faction with [[Clerics of Underfoot]] to complete this step.
*[[Kilij Plans]] drop from [[Sandgiant Husam]] in [[Southern Desert of Ro|South Ro]].
Give Nicholas the [[Kilij Plans]] and receive the [[Mold of Ro Boots]].
* You faction standing with [[Clerics of Underfoot]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[Kazon Stormhammer]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[Miners Guild 249]] got better.
You must have Amiable faction with [[Deepwater Knights]] to complete this step.
: David says, 'When you can swim the waters of Rathe and return two goblin nets from the elusive goblin net masters. then you will be rewarded the bracer mold.'
*[[Deepwater Goblin Net]]s drop from [[a goblin net master]] in [[Lake Rathe]].
Give David 2 [[Deepwater Goblin Net]]s and receive the [[Mold of Ro Bracer]].
* Your faction standing with [[Clockwork Gnome]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[Deepwater Knights]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[Heretics]] got worse.
You must have Amiable faction with [[Clerics of Tunare]] to complete this step.
*[[A Dark Cauldron]] drops from [[an ancille cook]] in [[Mistmoore Castle]].
Give Abigail 2 [[A Dark Cauldron]]s and receive the [[Mold of Ro Breastplate]].
You must have Amiable faction with [[Priests of Marr]] to complete this step.

: Sentry Joanna says, 'I will give you the mold. but first you will complete a task in the name of Erollisi Marr. My fellow Sentry. Alechin. was bitten by a wolf while he journeyed to Qeynos. He now turns into a werewolf at night. forced to kill innocent travelers. Go toward Qeynos. Release him from life and his curse and return his locket to me.'
*[[A Locket]] drops from [[Sentry Alechin]] or [[a werewolf]] in [[Southern Karana]].

Note: Killing Sentry Alechin damages your [[Knights of Truth]] and [[Priests of Marr]] faction. Waiting until nightfall and killing the werewolf that he becomes does not. As you will be in South Karana for a while camping the helm drops, you might as well wait until he changes to kill him.
Give Sentry Joanna [[A Locket]] and receive the [[Mold of Ro Gauntlets]].
Your faction standing with KnightsofTruth got better.
Your faction standing with FreeportMilitia got worse.
Your faction standing with PriestsofMarr got better.
You must have Amiable faction with [[Knights of Truth]] to complete this step.

: Elisabeth says, 'Go to the countryside of Freeport. There, you shall seek out any nightfall giants. They have terrorized the countryside for too long. They have protection from common weapons. Rely on magic. I failed in tracking them down. You shall succeed and when return any single head to me. you shall be awarded the mold for the greaves.'
*[[Nightfall Giant's Head]] drops from [[a nightfall giant]] in [[West Commonlands]].
Give Elisabeth [[Nightfall Giant's Head]] and receive [[Mold of Ro Greaves]].
You must have Amiable faction with [[Knights of Thunder]] to complete this step.

: Thomas says, 'To receive the mold of the Helm of Ro you must first demonstrate your strength. Go to the plains of thunder. There you shall hunt down the most vile creatures I have ever encounterd. Seek the undead cyclopes. I have spied them in the most dangerous portions of my realm. Fetch me two of their skulls.'

*[[Cyclops Skull]]s drop from [[An undead cyclops]] in [[Southern Karana]], The undead cyclops roams the area between Splitpaw and the Aviak city and share the spawn with a regular cyclops, lions and bull elephants.
Give Thomas two [[Cyclops Skull]]s and receive the [[Mold of Ro Helm]].
Your faction standing with KnightsofThunder got better.
Your faction standing with Bloodsabers got worse.
Your faction standing with PriestsofLife got better.
Your faction standing with GuardsofQeynos got better.
You must have Amiable faction with [[Priests of Life]] to complete this step.

: Marianna says, 'The mold will be offered to you when you have performed a task for the Temple of Life. The oceans near our home are host to a plague.. the plague sharks!!. They have been infected with a deadly malady which has been turning up in Qeynos Hills. Kill the sharks and bring me two of their rotten shark portions as proof.'

*[[Rotten Shark Meat]] drops from [[a plague shark]] in [[Erud's Crossing]]. There is a static plague shark spawn off the southern shore of the island which paths east to west across the length of the island. 2 hour spawn and the meat is a somewhat rare drop.
Give Marianna 2 [[Rotten Shark Meat]] and receive the [[Mold of Ro Vambrace]].

Once you have the mold for an item, you need to talk to [[Lord Searfire]], the Dwarven Smith in The Temple of Solusek Ro. He must consider you Amiably before he will deal with you. You will need an empty main inventory slot to use the [[Sol Cauldron]] he gives you.

: Lord Searfire says, 'Greetings! May the glory of Solusek Ro burn in your veins. I am the forge master of this temple. Called to service by the Burning Prince. Should you ever need my service and find me gone. have no fear. I shall return. I must occasionally venture to other realms in service of the temple. I shall always return. this is my eternal home.'
(Note: punctuation matches in-game text, there are no commas in the first reply)

You receive a [[Sol Cauldron]] (Lore). Combine the following ingredients (unstacked) in the Sol Cauldron to create [[A Bar of Ronium]]. Despite what Lord Searfire says, you do not need the [[Skill Blacksmithing|blacksmithing skill]] to combine these. This combine consumes the Sol Cauldron.
* Two Bars of [[Enchanted Platinum Bar|Enchanted Platinum]]
** A level 34 or higher enchanter with the [[Enchant Platinum]] spell is required to enchant vendor-purchased [[Platinum Bar]]s.
* [[Melatite]] (Dropped by MB and MC Clockworks in [[Solusek's Eye]].
** You can also sometimes buy them from the [[Gnome]]s in Solusek's Eye since many players sell them if they find them)

** If you are unable to get a group, you can hang around the Pond (west of area 13), CE (the ledge north of area 8) or CY (area 6) groups and ask to loot granite. It is often left to rot, or even destroyed. I got around 2 [[Mistmoore Granite]] per hour in a CE group.
* [[Sand of Ro]] (Dropped by [[A sand giant]], [[Cazel]], and [[Sandgiant Husam]] in [[Northern_Desert_of_Ro|North Ro]], [[Oasis_of_Marr|Oasis]], and [[Southern_Desert_of_Ro|South Ro]])
* [[Soil of Underfoot]] (Quested from [[Priestess Ghalea]] in the [[Kaladim]] cleric's guild)

** You MUST have at least amiable faction with Clerics of Underfoot, or the Priestess will take your items and give no reward. Give 4 [[Fairy Dust]]s to [[Priestess Ghalea]] to get 1 [[Soil of Underfoot]].
WARNING: The quest reward is a LORE item, use it before you try to get another.
1. "The Tower", close to the entrance, spawns two Grinning Gargoyles which have the lowest rate of dropping. This is the safest and slowest spot to get granite. Don't expect much at this spot.
3. At the "Castle Entrance", you can pull Gargoyles from inside castle and from the "Canyon" although Gargoyles don't spawn here. A good spot for experience and granite.

4. Past the Secret Room (SR), inside a little bit from the Tower, there are 2 gargoyles there (you turn left at the top of the stairs past the SR and its through the torture room...so you'll have to clear first)...this is near the Spa room where Xicotl the troll SK spawns (he has the hilt for [[SoulFire]]). If you go down the set of stairs from where those 2 gargoyles (instead of turning left and passing through the fake wall to the spa). There are 2 more gargoyles there and also another spawn (dark elf caster or melee types). Clear out this room. And then you can work 6 gargoyle spawns. The 2 up the stairs, 2 in that room and down yet another set of stairs are 2 more gargoyles and an occasional hallway roamer. So far this is the best place I have seen to get granite because you are working 6 gargoyle spawns. If you have a good group, you don't even need to be invis to get there... just fight your way in. Be careful that Xicotl isn't up...and don't go near the spa if so...as pulling him is dangerous if you are not prepared. (Mid 30's group should have little trouble with it).

**The only way to raise faction with the DW knights is to kill [[Elial Brook]] at the docks in Toxxulia Forest. He spawns every 10 minutes. He is a Necro and is often with pet.  I also found killing [[Aglthin Dasmore]] and [[Noclin Saah]] does the same thing.

**Once your faction is at Indifferent or Amiable, you can probably start doing quests directly from the Prexus temple.: [[Zombie Flesh Quest]] for facton at Deepwater Knights. This is for the Bracers. [[The Estate of Unrest]] is a good source for this.
**[[Odus Pearls]] Weligon Steelherder is also looking for Odus Pearls from the Odus harbor. These pearls sit underneath some very easy sharks.

**The best way to raise Clerics of Underfoot and Miners Guild 249 faction is by bone chips questing. Give bone chips to Gunlok Jure in the Kaladim Paladin guild. This may take a couple hundred bone chips.

**Give 2 gold to Lashun Novashine and/or 2 bone chips to raise Priests of Life faction.

**A way to raise faction with the Priests of Marr is to give [[Bottle of Milk|bottles of milk]] to Mojak Hikspin, who fishes by the lake in West Commonlands. Giving Mojax milk will spawn a npc named Duggin Scumper, a thief. Kill Duggin and return the note to [[Eestyana Naestra]] in the Hall of Truth in North Freeport. If you dont want to run back and forth from WC to NFP, you can just keep giving milk to Mojax. You can give him up to 4 individual bottles (one in each trade slot) at a time.
**Kill Orcs for Knights of Truth faction in the common lands or assist people who are killing orcs.
*[[Temple Of Sol Ro]] ([[The Temple of Solusek Ro]])
**The best way to raise Temple of Sol Ro faction is to seek out Rathmana in South Ro (NW corner of zone), and give him 30 gold at at time (it must be 30 gold, 3pp will not work).
**Alternatively, if you're a dervish hunter, you can turn in 4 dervish rings to Ortallius, the orc who is next to Rathmana.

**If you hang around Mistmoore a lot, you can raise faction there if you camp in the graveyard. There is a [[Flower]] that spawns in the crypt, which you can give to an outcast Shadowman named [[Ssynthi]], who sits behind the crypt building. Be careful of the invisible pit traps inside the crypt! You simply go to the Graveyard in MM. In the tomb you will see a bag, pick it up. You'll find a flower on your cursor. Go behind the Tomb and there is an outcast Shadowed Man named Synthi there, give her the flower. Rinse and repeat. The flower spawns every 1 minute. When Synthi cons amiable to you, your faction is high enough.

p99_evidence_lines.text: Armor of the Priest is a set of [[Cleric]] specific armor obtained through quests offered in [[The Temple of Solusek Ro]]. The level range for the quests are around the low 20s to mid 30s. The quests are offered by Blaize the Radiant and Gavel the Temperant.

Turn the following in to [[Blaize the Radiant]]
* [[Icon of the Fervent]] (Obtained by trading a [[Tumpy Tonic]] to Jovan in the Lumberyards of [[Highpass Hold]].)

Turn the following in to [[Blaize the Radiant]]
* [[Icon of the Reliant]] (Turgan's Note is a ground spawn, inside of a burnt hut in [[Kithicor Woods]], at 1700, 1100. Give the note to Turgan in [[Lake Rathetear]] at 3641.08, 149.10.)
* [[Ingot of the Reliant]] (Ground spawn on a tree stump in Kithicor. Jump off of the adjacent fallen tree onto the stump at -90, 3300.)
Turn the following in to [[Blaize the Radiant]]
* [[Icon of the Ardent]] (Drops off of [[Boondin Babbinsbort]], a gnome necromancer, on the third floor of [[Befallen]].)
* [[Ingot of the Ardent]] (Ground spawn in [[Everfrost Peaks]] at 2984, -5716. You'll most likely need Enduring Breath to get to it.  It's very hard to see and blends into the river floor.)
Turn the following in to [[Gavel the Temperant]]{{CheckboxList}}
* 2x [[Galvanized Platinum Bar]] (Give 1 [[Enchanted Platinum Bar]] to [[Genni]] for each bar needed.)
* [[Icon of the Constant]] (Drops off of [[Sludge Dankmire]] in the well on the fourth level of [[Clan Runnyeye]].)
* [[Ingot of the Constant]] (Drops off of [[Dwigus Lowater]] in [[Dagnor's Cauldron]] on the island.)
Turn the following in to [[Gavel the Temperant]]
* [[Ingot of the Reverent]] (drops off of [[Regis the Reverent]] in North Karana.)
* [[Icon of the Reverent]] (Give [[Lianna's Flute]] to [[Lianna]] in the [[Rathe Mountains]] (3989.64, 1477.37 ) in order to receive the Icon of the Reverent.)

Turning in the Flute to Lianna is only for the [[Icon of the Reverent]]. '''IMPORTANT: DO NOT''' turn in the Enchanted Platinum Bars, and both ingots to '''Lianna'''! * Your faction standing with Bloodsabers has been adjusted by -20.
* Your faction standing with Priests of Life has been adjusted by 15.
* Your faction standing with Guards of Qeynos has been adjusted by 15.
You receive some coin and a random spell scroll.

facets.match: Read the full cached checklist and detailed walkthrough plus all 18 mapped quest actors, including both Fajio, Andad and Forpar aliases. Torch relay is Konia 20532 -> Fajio 20533 -> Andad 20534 -> Misty 20379 -> Konia 20376 (Page 24 Top). Doll route is Baenar 20372 invoice -> Marfen 20370 mechanical doll -> Serra 20371 note -> Baenar 20368 note -> Maligar hostile doppleganger 12173, whose 20367 head -> Baenar 20366 bongos -> Konia 20383 (Page 24 Bottom). Kelkim consumes one each 20527 Chromodrac Gut, 20528 Red Wurm Gut and 20529 Onyx Drake Gut for 20377 Page 25. Optional Vedico 20530 Alluring Horn -> 20378 introduction -> Forpar 20380 note; the documented introduction-free components dialogue also supplies 20380. Forpar consumes 20380 plus 20524 Kedge Backbone, 20525 Petrified Werewolf Skull and 5520 Amygdalan Tendril for 20535 head; one each 11602 White Dragon Scales, 11622 Red Dragon Scales and 16905 Metal Bits for 20536 body. The singular Metal Bits count matches the page's explicit clarification. Undead Bard returns 20536, attacks the contributor, and only after that accepted hand-in its death handler spawns quest Trakanon 89181. Forpar 20535+20536+20526 Undead Dragongut Strings -> 20538 Mystical Lute; Baldric 20376+20383+20377+20538 -> 20542 Singing Short Sword. Optional lore introduction remains separate: Serra's note dialogue supplies Flyer 20374, Belious accepts it and 50 platinum supplies 20373 introduction to Baenar. The current doll hand-in supplies Note 20371, not the optional Flyer, matching the page's newer clarification. All complete trade handlers read, including returns and branch priority.
facets.discrepancy: P99 explicitly marks experience after Fajio, Andad, Misty and final Forpar exchanges, but effective sources award none (Andad's Ding is not XP). Retained Fajio/Misty/Forpar Perl supplies no numeric fallback, so do not invent amounts. Several replies are abridged; Forpar's body response says 'one more piece to go' while its handler accepts 'one more to go', and the head reply omits the next-pieces prompt. Undead Bard attacks in place rather than explicitly respawning as described by P99; transformed combat state/stat equivalence is unproven.
facets.unknown: The documented approximately 18-hour Undead Bard spawn, real-Trakanon interference, raid combat, loot settlement, original quest-era transition, and corpse availability are not established by reading the death trigger. Static named-NPC loot candidates are recorded separately in bard-loot-comparison.json, with later-era variants retained as candidates rather than certified P99 spawns. Exact XP for Konia 1000, Kelkim 5000, Belious 100 and Baldric 350000 is unquantified by the page. Reward item and proc raw rows are preserved in bard-reward-data.json; haste/STR/ATK/group radius metadata is inspected, but instrument amplification, duration calculation, proc triggering and live combat are not certified. Recommended level 46 is not treated as an undocumented universal hand-in gate. No screenshot or world-play parity claim. The optional Zordakalicus Ragefire red-scale route did not produce a candidate in this bounded scan; that is a coverage boundary, not proof the item cannot drop there.
facets.proposal: Approved p99-af-forpar-dialogue adds the documented final-component phrase to both Forpar aliases without altering any exchange. Four hash-bound mocked scenarios pass, including all four preserved hand-ins and partial/surplus input handling. Missing XP stays unquantified.

p99_evidence_lines.text: [[File:FaussP99ServerFirstSingingShortSword.jpg|200px|thumb|Project1999 Server First Singing Short Sword -- Fauss]]
[[File:MeanersEpic3.PNG|200px|thumb|Project1999 Green Server First Singing Short Sword -- Meaners Fu'gue]]
* Talk to [[Konia Swiftfoot]] in [[Western Karana]] (guard tower #4), receive a [[Torch of Misty]]
* Give the torch to [[Fajio Knejo]] in [[Misty Thicket]], receive [[Torch of Ro]]
* Give the torch to [[Andad Filla]] in [[Southern Desert of Ro|South Ro]], receive [[Torch of Rathe]]
* Give the torch to [[Misty Tekchita]] in [[Lake Rathetear]], receive ring [[Proof of Speed]]
* Give the ring to [[Konia Swiftfoot]] in [[Western Karana|W Karana]], receive [[Maestro's Symphony Page 24 Top]]
* Ask [[Baenar Swiftsong]] in [[South Karana]], “what doll,” receive [[Solusek Mining Company Invoice]]
* Take the invoice to [[Marfen Binkdirple]] in [[Solusek's Eye]], receive [[Mechanical Doll]]
* Give the doll to [[Serra]] in [[Unrest]], receive [[Note for Baenar]] previously [[Ripped Qeynos Bards Guild Flyer]] ? I didn't get this 2nd one on turn in 2/6/25
* Give the note to [[Baenar Swiftsong]] in [[South Karana]], receive a [[Note to Maligar]]
* Give the note to [[Maligar]] in [[Western Plains of Karana]]
* Kill [45][[Maligar's Enraged Doppleganger]], loot his head
* Give [[Maligar's Head]] to [[Baenar Swiftsong]], receive [[Mahlin's Mystical Bongos]].
* Give [[Mahlin's Mystical Bongos]] to [[Konia Swiftfoot]] in [[Western Karana]] (guard tower #4), receive [[Maestro's Symphony Page 24 Bottom]]
* Kill [36][[Blackwing]] in [[Rathe Mountains]], loot [[Onyx Drake Gut]]
* Kill [51][[Nezekezena]] or [47][[Phurzikon]] in [[Burning Woods]], loot [[Red Wurm Gut]]
* Kill [51][[Eldrig the Old]] in [[Skyfire Mountains]], loot [[Chromodrac Gut]]
* Give all the guts to [[Kelkim Menkia]] in [[South Karana]], receive [[Maestro's Symphony Page 25]]
* ('''OPTIONAL''') Kill [45][[Quag Maelstrom]] in [[Ocean of Tears]], loot [[Alluring Horn]].
* ('''OPTIONAL''') Give [[Alluring Horn]] to [[Vedico Windwhisper]] in [[Butcherblock Mountains]], receive a [[Note to Forpar Fizfla]].
* ('''OPTIONAL''') Give [[Note to Forpar Fizfla]] to [[Forpar Fizfla]] in [[Steamfont Mountains]].
* Kill [53][[Phinigel Autropos]] in [[Kedge Keep]], loot [[Kedge Backbone]]
* Kill an [48][[Amygdalan warrior]] in [[Plane of Fear]], loot [[Amygdalan Tendril]]
* Kill [52][[Drolvarg Warlord]] in [[Karnor's Castle]], loot [[Petrified Werewolf Skull]]
* Say "What Components" to [[Forpar Fizfla]] in [[Steamfont Mountains]], Receive [[Forpar's Note to Himself]].
* Give [[Forpar's Note to Himself]], [[Kedge Backbone]], [[Amygdalan Tendril]], [[Petrified Werewolf Skull]] to [[Forpar Fizfla|Forpar]] and receive [[Mystical Lute Head]]
* Kill a red dragon ([[Lord Nagafen]], [[Zordakalicus Ragefire]], [[Talendor]]) or  [[Nortlav the Scalekeeper]] and loot [[Red Dragon Scales]]
* Kill a white dragon ([[Lady Vox]], [[Gorenaire]]), loot [[White Dragon Scales]]
* Give 1 [[metal bits]] (smithed), [[Red Dragon Scales]] and [[White Dragon Scales]] to [[Forpar Fizfla|Forpar]], receive [[Mystical Lute Body]]
* Give [[An Undead Bard]] your [[Mystical Lute Body]]. Kill [[An Undead Bard]], upon death he spawns [[Trakanon (triggered)]], kill [[Trakanon (triggered)]] and loot [[Undead Dragongut Strings]].
* Give [[Mystical Lute Head]], [[Mystical Lute Body]] and [[Undead Dragongut Strings]] to [[Forpar Fizfla|Forpar]], receive the [[Mystical Lute]]
* Give [[Maestro's Symphony Page 24 top]], [[Maestro's Symphony Page 24 bottom]], [[Maestro's Symphony Page 25]] and [[Mystical Lute]] to [[Baldric Slezaf]], receive [[Singing Short Sword]]

The Quest starts in the [[Dreadlands]] where you must find Baldric Slezaf.  He is located in the Undead pyramid city near the teleport areas.  He was inside the far west pyramid, location was positive 770, positive 9700.  (Thanks Talespin Spellwind for location.)  Baldric Slezaf will ask you for four items.  They are the top part of page 24, the bottom part of page 24, page 25, and a Lute made by Forpar Fizfla.
The quest for the top part of page 24 starts in [[Western Karana]], where you must find Konia Swiftfoot in the guard tower (#4 on map) -516 , -2433.

Misty is in [[Lake Rathetear]] (#13 on map)  If she is there when you get there you can find her near the entrance to the Arena.  Misty will give you a Ring called [[Proof of Speed]].  Return this ring to Konia Swiftfoot and you will get the top part of page 24.

Take the Invoice to Marfen Binkdirple in [[Solusek's Eye]] and he will give you A Mechanical Doll.  Give this doll to Braenar's Daughter, Serra.  She is in [[The Estate of Unrest]] next to the Gnome Spelunker on the right on the mansion.  If you are KoS to him, you will need to mesmerize the spelunker or a group to kill him.  Serra will give you a note to give to Braenar.  He will give you another note to give to Maligar.

Maligar is found in West Karana at approximately +1300 , -11500.  He appears to be on Karana Bandit faction, so your deity choice and history with Karana Bandits will determine if you are KoS. If you are KoS, you can try sneak, the Mask of Deception, Cinda's Charismatic Carillon, Charm or a combination of these to turn the note in to him. When you give him the note, [[Maligar's Enraged Doppleganger]] will spawn and Maligar should despawn.  You must then kill the Doppleganger to loot [[Maligar's Head]].  This should be doable with a standard group of high 40's to low 50's.
Take Maligar's Head to Braenar and he will give you [[Mahlin's Mystical Bongos]].  Take the Bongo's to Konia for the bottom half of page 24.

Now to find page 25.  First talk to Kelkim Menkia, a female npc in [[Southern Karana]] at -245, -3650.  She asks you to bring her 3 guts from 3 wurms and drakes.  The first guts drops from [[Eldrig the Old]].  He is a rare spawn chromodrake in [[Skyfire Mountains]].  It drops Chromodrac guts which are the guts you  need.

The next guts are dropped from Nezekezena, a named wurm level 51 in the [[Burning Woods]].  Reports indicate that if you go to Nezekezena's spawn location (about -450, -2550 in Burning Wood) and kill everything in sight, eventually Nez or his (her?) placeholders will start spawning with a cycle time of 90 seconds. People have evidenced acquiring Burning Embers at a rate of 1 or 2 in a few hours' time with this method. Phurzikon and Nezekezena both spawn on this spot, and they are both strong; sometimes Nez or Phurz will spawn two times in a row, so your group had better be strong enough to take them.  Nezekezena, if not killed when she spawns, will wander sometimes along the east and south walls of the zone, so if you can't find her near her spawn, look there. A tracker would definitely help.  The guts you need from her are red wurm guts.  The best way to do this camp, is have someone in your guild with an extra computer bring a ranger to the zone.  Then continually track for a week or so until you get it on track.  Phurzikon drops a very nice resistance shoulder called wurm scale coat.  This might be a good way to convince people to help you camp these two wurms.  Phurzikon also drops an item for the Magician epic.
The last guts are dropped from [[Blackwing]] in [[Rathe Mountains]].  See instructions on how to spawn him on the actual page for [[Blackwing]]

Now for the final part.  You must get talk to Forpar Fizfla.  You must complete three quests for him.  After each quest he will reward you will part of the lute.  He can usually be found in the middle windmill.

The First Quest is for the Head and Neck of the lute.  Go to Vedico Windwisper in the [[Butcherblock Mountains]].  She is on the docks.  She asks that you bring the Alluring Horn.  This horn is dropped off of [[Quag Maelstrom]].  He is a level 45 mob in [[Ocean of Tears]], only one zone away from Vedico.  The following information was cited by an anonymous person on Illia's Beastiary. He's generally on the Seafury Cyclops island around 1000, -6000. He conned red to me at 42 and he casts drain mana a lot, (which curiously did not appear to lower my bardic mana bar at all). I was able to land a lot of Chants of Flame and Curtailing Chants so his fire/magic resistances may not be that high. He didn't hit me all that much, but if memory serves he was hitting me for around 100 or 120 per shot.  He's generally seen wielding this odd weapon which looks like a thin tree trunk skewering the alluring horn he carries, which tends to make him stand out from the others. There are a good number of cyclopses on the small island, so pulling Quag alone isn't easy. But sometimes he stomps over to the shore by himself (to look in the water I guess). I don't know if he spawns all the time, or if you have to trigger his spawn by talking to the disgruntled elf at the BB docks. I went to talk to the elf first just in case, and by the time I got to the island Quag was there, and didn't despawn over the several hours I took to gauge the island and set up my offensive.

The first thing is called Backbone of an Ancient Fisherman or Phinigel's Spine.  It is found off of the [[Phinigel Autropos]] in [[Kedge Keep]].  Phinigel Autropos is a level 50 Wizard.  He can be taken out with 1 well structured 55+ group.  He enjoys dispelling people (usually your enduring breath.)  His guardians are level 51. He is mezzable, his guardians are not, and they can complete heal. With new gear, a group of 5 people can easily do this, as long as you have one level 60 to pull (only lvl 60s can get him solo.)

The second thing is a Amygdalan Tentacle or Amygdalan Tendril.  These are 9/25 1h slashing weapons that drop from Amygdalan Warriors and rarely Knights in [[Plane of Fear]].  They are both level 48-52 but the knights can heal, summon pets, and harmtouch.

The third thing is a Petrified Skull of Lycanthrope or petrified werewolf skull.  This is dropped from the Drolvarg Warlord in [[Karnor's Castle]].  This is a level 51-54 Drolvarg who spawns in the Warlord room.
Hand in the three items and the note to Forpar and he will give you the head and neck of the lute.

The first item is a Large Red Dragon Scale.  This is most commonly dropped by [[Lord Nagafen]], a level 55 dragon in [[Nagafen's Lair]] but can also be found off of [[Zordakalicus Ragefire]], or [[Talendor]] in [[Skyfire Mountains]]. There is also a mob in [[The Hole]] named [[Nortlav the Scalekeeper]].  He is a level 51-55 Erudite that drops the Red Dragon Scale.  He hits for about 190 on average.  He has a nasty lifetap that does around 1500 damage and heals him for around 20%.  He also uses harmtouch, and has a very high magic resist.
Now find the Large White Dragon Scale from [[Lady Vox]] in Permafrost, or [[Gorenaire]] in the [[Dreadlands]].
Turn these three items in for the body of the lute.
Once you get the body, Forpar will offer to give you the strings to the lute as long as you bring him one thing: [[Undead Dragongut Strings]] from [[Trakanon]].

Once you get the body, Forpar will offer to give you the strings to the lute as long as you bring him one thing: Trakanon's Guts.  These drop off of a clone of [[Trakanon]].  He is exactly the same except he always drops the guts.  To get him to spawn, go to Trak's lair while he is not spawned.  Give the body of the lute to An Undead Bard which spawns about 18 hours after a normal Trakanon is killed.   He will hand it back to you and then attack you.  He is level 55 monster.  Once he is killed, the clone of Trakanon will spawn.  Trakanon claws for 650, with a sickening melee range, and his breath attack has been known to kill whole groups in minutes.  The regular Trakanon does not drop the guts.  You must force spawn the clone through the undead bard.   Now give Forpar the Trakanon Guts, the Head and Neck of the Lute (One Item) and the Body of the Lute for Forpar's Mystical Lute.

You are nearly there!  Go back to the Dreadlands and find Baldric.  Give him Maestro's Symphony Page 24 Top, Maestro's Symphony Page 24 Bottom, Page 25, Mystical Lute.  He will give you the {{:Singing Short Sword}}!
'''Visit Baldric Slezaf, located inside a pyramid at +775, +9665, around the portal area of the [[Dreadlands]].'''

'''To get top part page 24 go to [[Western Karana]] and see Konia Swiftfoot, who may be found inside a guard tower at -500, -2400. She gives you a Torch of Misty and starts a race. Take the torch to Fajio Knejo in Misty Thicket (close to the wall guards). He gives you a Torch of Ro. Then take that torch to Andad Filla in South Ro (close to innothule zone) who gives you a Torch of Rathe. Then take that torch to Misty Tekchita in Lake Rathe (by arena zone). This will get you Proof of Speed. Finally, take this back to Konia Swiftfoot and you will get the top part of page 24.'''

Konia Swiftfoot says 'Here you go. Run with this torch as fast as you can to the misty thicket and hand this torch off to Fajio Knejo. He will tell you where to go from there. Hurry! You do not have much time!'
Misty Tekcihta hands you a small ring.

'''To get the bottom half of you need to give Konia Swiftfoot Mahlin's Mystical Bongos. Talk to Baenar Swiftsong at location -15, +100 in South Karana. He will give you an invoice after you ask "what doll?". Go to Solusek A and give the gnome vendor Marfen the invoice and you will receive a doll. Take the doll to the Estate of Unrest and give the doll to Serra, who is next to the gnomish speulunker. Serra will give you a Ripped Qeynos Bard Guild Flyer. Now take this from Serra back to Braenar, who will give a new note for Maligar. Take the note from Braenar to Maligar. Maligar's Enraged Doppleganger will attack at that point (bring a group). Kill the Doppleganger and loot his head. Take the head back to Braenar and receive "Mahlin's Mystical Bongos". Take the bongos to Konia Swiftfoot in West Karana to get the bottom of Page 24.'''
Serra claps her hands. 'Oh goody! But... I cannot seem to remember his name. He gave me this note before I...'
At this point, she hands you a Ripped Qeynos Bards Guild Flyer.
Give him the Flyer and he says the exact same thing as above and you get experience.
'''You receive A Letter of Introduction and some experience gain.'''
'''Return to Baenar Swiftsong in South Karana'''
Go to Sol A.  [[Marfen Binkdirple]] is the same gnome that sells the Tinker’s bag.  He can be found at –304, -1083.
'''Return to Unrest and hand Serra the Mechanical Doll.'''
''Maligar is a level 45 Shadowknight who spawns in West Karana at pos 179, neg 10878. He is KoS, and you should sneak or charm him to turn in the note to him.''

Maligar says 'I see you do not share my sense of humor.  Let’s read it shall we?  Oh, no!  She’s dead?  I knew that already, you fool.  It was by my hand she died!  Ooops!  Did I let that slip out?  Silly me.  I guess I will have to kill you now!'
'''At this point Maligar despawns and [[Maligar's Enraged Doppleganger]] spawns.  Kill him and loot [[Maligar's Head]].  Turn Maligar's Head into Baenar Swiftsong in South Karana.'''
'''You receive [[Mahlin's Mystical Bongos]].  Deliver the bongos to [[Konia Swiftfoot]] in West Karana.
'''Find these three items and give them to her to receive Page 25:'''
*Chromodrac Gut (dropped by [[Eldrig the Old]], a named chromodrac in [[Skyfire Mountains]])
*Red Wurm Gut (dropped by Nezekezena, a named wurm in the [[Burning Woods]])
*Onyx Drake Gut (dropped by [[Blackwing]], an onyx drake in [[Rathe Mountains]])

Kelkim Menkia snatches the gut strings from your hand and immediately begins to string her lute. 'This is wonderful, I will be able to play my lute again soon! Take this old sheet of music I found - I don't think I will have much use for it. My new desire is to bash gnoll heads in with my lute. Safe travels to you, Kenayne.'
'''Now you need Forpar's Lute. This is rewarded as head, body and strings.'''
# Backbone of an Ancient Fishman - Kedge Backbone from [[Phinigel Autropos]] in [[Kedge Keep]].
# Amalgam Tentacle - Amygdalan Tendril from [[Plane of Fear]].
# Petrified Skull of a Lycanthrope - Petrified Werewolf Skull from [[Karnor's Castle]] off a Drolvarg Warlord.

Forpar Fizfla says 'Wow! I didn't think a Human like you would be able to gather all of those things.' Forpar rambles around and works with small tools for a good ten minutes before handing you a very fine looking lute head. 'Now, do you want to gather the next pieces for me?'
# Red Dragon Scales from [[Talendor]], [[Lord Nagafen]], or [[Nortlav the Scalekeeper]].
# White Dragon Scales from [[Gorenaire]] or [[Lady Vox]].
# [[Metal Bits]] (regular smithed metal bits). (There's been some confusion because the name of the item is plural, but you really only need one copy of this. Verified in-game.)
Next, gather your raid force and kill [[Trakanon]]. Loot his [[Undead Dragongut Strings]].
'''Find An Undead Bard in [[Old Sebilis]] at -2085, -705.'''
: An Undead Bard says 'Well then, I would ask you a favor for one in return. If I bring that cursed dragon here, will you kill it for me?'
: An Undead Bard says 'Give me the Mystical Lute Body you have. I will return it, don't worry. I only wish to hold an instrument one last time before I leave.'

'''You get the Mystical Lute Body back. It respawns and attacks. Kill it to spawn the triggered version of Trakanon. Loot the [[Undead Dragongut Strings]] from this triggered version. If the real version is up, it will kill An Undead Bard and you must wait until UDB spawns again.'''
'''Once you have all three lute parts, give the following to Forpar to receive the mystical lute: the head, body and gut strings.'''

Forpar Fizfla says 'Goodness! I can hardly contain myself! This will be my greatest creation ever!' Forpar sits down, slides the lute head into place and screws it together. After a few minutes, he begins to string the lute with the gut strings of the poison dragon. A wonderful sound fills the air as he strums the lute once and hands it to you. 'I hope you find a good use for that! I bet you could play it from the mountaintops and the people below would hear you. Thank you, ______, for making my lifelong dream come true!'

Baldric Slezaf looks shocked as you hand him the pages and the mystical lute. 'I will put on a symphony the likes of which the gods have never seen. Thank you so much, ______. Please take this sword as a token of my gratitude.'
'''He will reward you with the [[Singing Short Sword]].'''

p99_evidence_lines.text: Ally faction is required for all Kael armor quests.
Bygloirn Omorden smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well, _____.'
* Your faction standing with [[Kromzek]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[Kromrif]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[King Tormax (Faction)|King Tormax]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[Claws of Veeshan]] got worse.

p99_evidence_lines.text: The term "'''Bard Mail'''" is usually used to refer to the group of quests: [[Going Postal]]

The idea is to run back and forth doing this delivery repeatedly. Time wise, running this quest can be comparable  to killing the bats and wolves that inhabit the area. Especially at times when the zone is crowded with new players, or when SoW is Available. On this point: Its recommended to find a druid using "/who druid" ( Sow is a level 14 spell), as having SoW will about double your rate of experience gain while doing this quest.  (If there is any, offer to meet them or donate for Sow at the "PoD Lift")
Head to [[Felwithe]] in the South East corner of [[Greater Faydark]].

You can follow the path from [[Kelethin]] if you started there. You will go around some corners, do not turn at any junctions you pass. Eventually the path stops in a T intersection.  Turn left at this T intersection and you should see the front gate of Felwithe loading in immediately in front of you. (Felwithe Entrance loc: -1980, -2308)

Inside the city, head across the bridge and into the tunnel on the right. Just through this tunnel, you will see Tascar Tissleplay standing to the left of the Entrance to Faydark's Bane. (Number 7 on the [[Felwithe]] Map)
(On all subsequent trips back to Tascar you can simply target him and say "'''i will deliver to Kelethin'''" to receive a new letter.)

After Leaving Felwithe veer right, across the grass, and follow the path back to Kelethin. (Do not turn at the junction you pass) After some turns, the path ends at the 1st lift of Kelethin (loc 52, -148) Take the lift up, then take the bridge to the right to the next platform.  From this platform there will be a bridge on the left leading to the Bard's Guildhall.  Inside the guildhall, in the first room on the right will be Jakum Webdancer. (Bards guild is number 14 on the [[Kelethin]] Map)
Hand the letter to him to receive '''XP''' and a '''random amount of gold, 1-16 pieces'''.
You will also Receive the following Faction Changes:
After the turn in, take the lift you took up into the city back down. The path makes a right turn, just past the lift and your on your way back to Felwithe!

2) It is best to sick to the path if you don't know the way ([[Sense Heading]] anyone?), and keep your eyes on the road, as the aggressive orcs and black wolves can be lethal at these levels. Times will vary based on load time at Felwithe and how much of the path you need to follow.
5) At level 5 (wood elf druid) the quest turn in gives 1/2 a yellow per completion.
At level 9, this was a safe and reliable source of experience, though not spectacular.

p99_evidence_lines.text: | [[Lake of Ill Omen]], [[Frontier Mountains]], [[Swamp of No Hope]], [[Kaesora]]
This spell was added with EQ's first expansion Ruins of Kunark, and therefore the entire quest is done in Kunark.  The zones involved zones are circled in red on the map above.
Go to [[Lake of Ill Omen]] and head to the Sarnak Fort at -2000, +2000. Any sarnak can spawn [[A Sarnak revealer]], thats who you need to kill for [[Farsight Crystal]].

Go to either of the marked spots on the map in [[Frontier Mountains]]. Kill Sarnaks until [[A sarnak partisan]] Spawns. Kill the Partisans for [[Pouch of Dust]]. It does not drop every time, so keep killing them until you get it. Be aware that Sarnak Partisans cast blind. One has enough mana to cast it 5-6 times.

EDIT 2: another location to get the [[Pouch of Dust]] is a static spawn just north of the Overthere Outpost. Other sarknak types can also spawn there, but I confirm I got a Pouch of Dust from that mob.
Go to [[Firiona Vie]] and kill [[Froglok Tsu Shaman]]s for [[Tsu Shaman Powder]] drop.
Go to [[Kaesora]], [[Droga]] or [[Nurga]] and kill [[strathbone spider]]s for [[Strathbone Silk]].
Find [[Shrub Marwood]] in the eastern hideout of the Firiona Vie outpost.

Turn these four items in to Shrub Marwood and receive "Fertile Crop." Scribe this spell into your spellbook and its name will change to Beguile Plants. NOTE: the scroll is no drop so can't be traded or sold.

p99_evidence_lines.text: : Talisyn Stormwing furrows his troubled brow in confusion and surprise. 'You need ask such a question and receive answers in the form of words to understand what it is that surrounds you, Danian ? Have you neither heard nor seen the vile creatures that inhabit the putrid lands of Mistmoore to the south? Or have you not seen the creatures forged from the very shadows that lie not to far from our homelands? The Teir`Dal beasts that have made camp not too far from the entrance of Mistmoore's lair? These evils, some ancient beyond our pilgrimage from Tunaria, have torn and marred these precious, beautiful forests. Unfortunately, a [greater evil] has descended, and thus my presence here.

: Talisyn Stormwing says 'Not too far in the recent past did Firiona Vie, the lovely and gracious Champion of Tunare, return to our homelands. In her return, she sought to bring forth the avatar of our sacred Mother to seek guidance on her path -- the path of Elven Kind. Little did the Champion know that The Faceless was close at bay, and through means unknown, his power was greater than that of our sacred Mother's. In a petty display of his new found power, the Lord of Fear [furthered the corruption] of these natural lands.

: Talisyn Stormwing closes his eyes and bows his head for a moment as if in mourning. 'The Faerie Folk that called this place their home have been changed into unnatural monsters of Cazic's will. They thirst for mortal blood and flesh, and have lost all innocent, grace, and reason that was once their existence. But they seem incomparable to [the greatest loss] to be turned in Cazic-Thule's favor.

: Talisyn Stormwing says 'I would be eternally grateful for your company, _____ and your pledge to this cause. However, I cannot expect anything of you. If [you are sure] that you would be willing to aid all of the Faydark, then I will be willing to give forward what knowledge I have gathered thus far.'

: Talisyn Stormwing says 'The Frightlings are what the corrupted Pixies have been calling themselves. I have found through my extensive scouting of the area that one called Bilewretch who acts as their leader. I have dreamed for many days now of his destruction at my bow, but unfortunately that would cause me to abandon my post, and leave myself vulnerable to attacks from the [Undead Sprites.] However, as you have pledged yourself to the cause, if you would bring me proof of Bilewretch's destruction, I shall reward you greatly for your service.'

: Talisyn Stormwing says 'They are the twisted monsters of what used to be the noble Faeries of the forest. Now, they are but fleshy beings that desire only to bring death for their dark amusements. As with the Frightlings, these unnatural beasts are lead by a fearsome creature that has named himself Bloodboil. Another despicable being that I wish to bring a swift death to, but cannot for fear of abandoning my post and failing my master. If you would be so brave and bring to me proof of this monster's demise, your efforts will not go unrewarded.'

=== Human Bard on Green99 (hybrid exp penalty) ===
At level 6, I turned in 164 Bone chips (8 stacks & 1 turn in) to get to level 7.

Levels 1-3 11% per turn in, ~40 per level 1-3

Level 4 9-10% per turn in (6 turn ins received 3 yellow bubbles or 60%)
Level 8 2-3% per turn in (8 turn ins received 1 yellow bubble or 20%)

At level 9, 1-2% xp per turn-in of 4 bone chips (~17% xp from 40 bone chips).
Based on the Ranger and Bard data, the quest turn-in is between 3165 to 3184 XP, unless that amount is more than 1/8 of a level or it completes the level.
The XP reward also cannot be more than 3184 XP, otherwise 40 turn-ins would have completed level 6 on the Ranger and Bard.

As a fun thought experiment. It requires 64,689,900 to go from level 59 to 60. At 3,184 xp per turn in it would require 20,318 turn ins to level from this quest. At 4 chips required per turn-in that is 81,272 bone chips. This is 4,064 stacks of bone chips. At a normal market price of 10p per stack thats 40,064 plat worth of chips. If it takes you 5 seconds to click in each quest turn in, it would take 101,590 non-stop seconds of clicking in bone chips. This is over 28 hours of clicking. This does not include all of the time it would take to transport or purchase this many stacks of bonechips.

p99_evidence_lines.text: :[[Dru Razbind]] says, 'Greetings, my friend. What brings you so far from the trodden path? I hope you do not plan on stealing my [fishing spot].'
:[[Dru Razbind]] says, 'I need this spot! I fish to feed my growling tummy. I can no longer [venture into Kaladim] and eat in its fine taverns.'

:[[Dru Razbind]] says, 'I have been disgraced! I used to be a respected paladin of the Church of Underfoot until I failed to complete a very [important task] for Lord Datur Nightseer. He stripped me of my Cape of Underfoot. I cannot walk the halls of Kaladim without my cape.'

:[[Dru Razbind]] says, 'I was ordered by Lord Nightseer to carry the [Chalice of Conquest] to a noble band of paladins in the mountains of Rathe. While there, the entire camp was overtaken by a band of orcs. During the battle there was a [strange occurrence].'

:[[Dru Razbind]] says, 'A large fray raged. Brave, valiant paladins fought vile, green-skinned orcs and while this happened, I spied the [Chalice of Conquest] being taken away from the camp. I was then distracted by a well placed orcish blade. After I defeated the orcs in my way, I turned to see a blue orc running toward the horizon. I gave chase to no avail. I lost the chalice and all respect. If only a [noble Paladin of Underfoot] would assist me...'
If you're not amiable (or better) to [[Paladins of Underfoot]] :
:[[Dru Razbind]] says, 'How dare you approach a member of the Clerics of Underfoot?! Dogs such as you lie in the same bed as aviaks and ogres!'

:[[Dru Razbind]] says, 'Yes, you shall do, noble _____. Take this. This is the Chalice Case. It is intended for the Chalice of Conquest and the [Candle of Bravery]. If you should get both, be sure to place them within the Chalice Case and combine them. Take the full Chalice Case to Lord Nightseer in Kaladim and I shall be redeemed and you shall surely earn a fine paladin's reward. Let your quest begin in the mountains of Rathe.'
He gives you a [[Chalice case - empty]].

:[[Dru Razbind]] says, 'The Candle of Bravery is ceremonial and is lit when one sips from the [Chalice of Conquest]. The candlestick was left with a fellow Paladin of Underfoot in the Rathe Mountains. The candle itself was lost and I do not know where Priestess Ghalea purchases them.'
Head to the mountains of Rathe. [[Nicholas]] is located in the paladin camp in the northeast part.
:[[Nicholas]] says, 'Greetings, friend. I am the keeper of the [Boots of Ro]. Please rest here with us in our camp of righteousness. No harm can come to you while we paladins keep watch.'

:[[Nicholas]] says, 'You must be the one Sir Dru of Kaladim sent to retrieve the candlestick which was broken in the [orc onslaught]. I have only this piece in my possession as the other portion was taken by an [odd druid] of these mountains. Should you reclaim it, I am sure the maker of the candlestick can patch it together.'
He gives you a [[Stem of Candlestick]].

:[[Nicholas]] says, 'The orcs attempted to take the hill, as they do on a frequent basis. We repelled them, of course, but a [blue orc] rushed off with the [Chalice of Conquest]. Where he came from, I do not know. He was no part of the battle! I believe he just found an opportune moment to loot our camp.'

:[[Nicholas]] says, 'I had a visiting ranger track him to his camp near Lake Rathetear. I spied the camp and saw his lifeless body near two other blue orcs. Apparently, he must have taken a fatal blow, but had enough stamina to make it to his camp. I returned the following day with my fellow paladins and found the camp long gone. The ranger, who was still with us, found two sets of tracks leading away. We found [orc remnants].'

:[[Nicholas]] says, 'Here. We found this worthless orc bracelet with the name Klunga on it. There was also an orc shovel and a bag of Cauldron prawns. We left them, of course. The camp has now been taken over by the green-skinned orcs. I would advise you to stay clear of this camp in Lake Rathe.'

:[[Nicholas]] says, 'The mountains have been plagued not only by beasts, but by evil druids! They attempt to force all men from this land. One has stolen the foot of the candlestick which holds the [Candle of Bravery]. I remember that battle cry of hers, 'Long live the green!'.'
The [[Foot of Candlestick]] drops off of Unkempt Druids in [[Rathe Mountains]]. Only the unnamed ones dropped it. It can be very rare.

Once you have the Stem and Foot of Candlestick pop into [[Lake Rathetear]] for the shovel. Follow the right side past the merchants, bandits until the orc camps. The [Abandoned Orc Shovel]] is a ground spawn at /loc +3486, -663 inside the 2nd tent.. You will need it later for the Chalice.
Now head to [[Priestess Ghalea]] in [[North Kaladim]] and ask her about the Candle of Bravery.

:[[Priestess Ghalea]] says,'Welcome to the Church of Underfoot. Please open your soul to the greatness of Brell Serilis. May he guide you in all your future endeavors. And may your soles long for the [Soil of Underfoot].'

:[[Priestess Ghalea]] says, 'The Candle of Bravery is used for temple ceremonies here in Kaladim. When the candle burns out, I must venture to the frigid village of Halas far to the north of the continent of Antonica. There I will take the candlestick and the [soil of Underfoot] to Dok. He must create the candle in the very ornate candlestick.'

:[[Priestess Ghalea]] says, 'I can trust you with the soil of Underfoot, but first you must obtain four portions of [[fairy dust]]. Return them to me and I shall mix it and pray over it. Then I shall give you a pouch of soil of Underfoot.'
Complete the [[Soil of Underfoot]] subquest, then head to [[Halas]]. [[Dok]] is located inside Dok's Cigars.
:[[Dok]], 'Fine day to ye, _____. Welcome to me shop. If ye're searchin' fer a [cigar], ye won't be findin' any, more's th' pity.'
:[[Dok]] says, 'I can make ye a Candle o' Bravery. I'll need th' candlestick, or pieces of it! And I need a honeycomb. Oh! And I need a pouch o' Underfoot soil as well.'
Hand him [[Stem of Candlestick]], [[Foot of Candlestick]], [[Honeycomb]] and [[Soil of Underfoot]].
:[[Dok]] says, 'Here is your Candle o' Bravery.'
* Your faction standing with [[Merchants of Halas]] has been adjusted by 5.
* Your faction standing with [[Wolves of the North]] has been adjusted by 3.
* Your faction standing with [[Shamen of Justice]] has been adjusted by 3.
Now that we have the [[Candle of Bravery]] complete we can focus the Chalice.
Off to [[Dagnor's Cauldron]]. The clue was the Cauldron prawns Nicholas mentioned.

Entering from Butcherblock and head left until you reach the orc camp. The [[Exiled Legionnaire]] has an orc scout as a PH. I did this at 35, but It can be done at 20. The legionnaire was level 22 and aggroed on spawn.
Kill him and loot the [[Blood Stained Note (Klunga's Blood)]].
The note mentions a gnome, [[Ghilanbiddle Nylwadil]]. He is in the Fabulous Four camp to the right of the butcherblock zone line.
:[[Ghilanbiddle Nylwadil]] says, 'What business do you have here?! Trying to keep safe? Expecting us to fight your battles? Bah!'

:[[Ghilanbiddle Nylwadil]] says, 'Looking for the chalice, are you? Ha! I don't know where it is, but I know a [lost soul] who does and he could lead you right to it. He had a taste of it and now he can't get enough. He is sort of under the weather, or do I mean under the ground? Ha!'

:[[Ghilanbiddle Nylwadil]] says, 'The orc named [[Captain Klunga]] knows where it's buried. Unfortunately, his time on Norrath has passed. I happen to know two things... one, he is buried somewhere in this territory and two, I can [raise Klunga] and he can show you where the chalice is.'

:[[Ghilanbiddle Nylwadil]] says, 'I can raise Captain Klunga if I have a portion of his blood, an item he once owned and the most important part, 100 gold coins! Hehe! A gnome's got to make a living, you know?'
Turn in the [[Blood Stained Note (Klunga's Blood)]] you just looted, [[Klunga's Bracelet]] and 100 gold.
:[[Ghilanbiddle Nylwadil]] says, 'The deal was - an article of Klunga's and his blood along with my fee of 100 gold coins and you will have his resurrection.'
:[[Ghilanbiddle Nylwadil]] says, 'The deal was - an article of Klunga's and his blood along with my fee of 100 gold coins and you will have his resurrection.'

:[[Ghilanbiddle Nylwadil]] says, 'Biggily boo, biggily borc... Raise that stinky orc! Bamm! Okay! It's done. Now all you have to do is find him in the spot where his soul left him and give him an orc shovel. Oh! I didn't mention that? Oh, well. I'm sure you can find one... somewhere. Now, get lost before I turn you into a toad!'
* Your faction standing with [[Eldritch Collective]] has been adjusted by 5.
* Your faction standing with [[Dark Reflection]] has been adjusted by -1.
* Your faction standing with [[The Dead]] has been adjusted by -1.
* Your faction standing with [[Gem Choppers]] has been adjusted by 1.
* Your faction standing with [[King Ak`Anon]] has been adjusted by 1.

Head back to the orc camp in Dagnor's Cauldron you just left. Next to the camp fire is [[Captain Klunga]], level 22, does not aggro and will not talk. Hand him the [[Abandoned Orc Shovel]] (I hope you looted it) and rises up heading west across the Cauldron. Swim to keep up with him until he gets out of the water across the zone to a patch of grass. He immediately drops a bag and goes aggro. Kill him.
Pick up the bag on the ground, it's the chalice. Now combine the [[Chalice of Conquest]] and the [[Candle of Bravery]] in the empty Chalice case.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: [[Chalice Case]].
Head to [[Datur Nightseer]] in [[North Kaladim]] for the turn in.

:[[Datur Nightseer]] says, 'The chalice is returned! Praise be to Brell! You have proven yourself to our church and have earned our respect. Let me welcome you into our brotherhood with the Cape of Underfoot. Wear it with pride as all of our finest paladins do.'
* Your faction standing with [[Clerics of Underfoot]] has been adjusted by 15.
* Your faction standing with [[Kazon Stormhammer]] has been adjusted by 15.
* Your faction standing with [[Miners Guild 249]] has been adjusted by 11.
Back to the Butcherblock docks for the final turn in. Hand Dru Razbind the cloak you just received.

:[[Dru Razbind]] says, 'I thank you, my friend. You are truly a great paladin and noble addition to our ranks. I now can walk in Kaladim. Take this as a reward. It is the Holy Partisan of Underfoot. It is now yours. I believe it still has a couple of charges. Use it wisely as the only cleric able to recharge it was lost amid the lava filled lands of Antonica.'
* Your faction standing with [[Paladins of Underfoot]] has been adjusted by 10.
* Your faction standing with [[Kazon Stormhammer]] has been adjusted by 7.
* Your faction standing with [[Clerics of Underfoot]] has been adjusted by 10.
* Your faction standing with [[Veeshan]] could not possibly get any better.

p99_evidence_lines.text: [[File:P99Server1stClericEpic.jpg|200px|thumb|Project1999 Server First Water Sprinkler of Nem`Ankh - Getsome]]

As of 4/30/2014, Natasha Whitewater will despawn 5 minutes after spawning in Lake Rathetear unless engaged in combat and after turning in the Damaged goblin crown. : https://www.project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=147244 & https://www.project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=166462&page=3
Additional Notes: Whoever turns in "Shimmering Pearl" to Zordak Ragefire has 20 minutes to engage Zordakalicus Ragefire, after 20 minutes has elapsed, it goes FFA.
* Loot [[Lord Bergurgle's Crown]] from [[Lord Bergurgle]] in [[Lake Rathetear]]

:* Give [[Lord Bergurgle's Crown]] to [[Shmendrik Lavawalker]] in [[Lake Rathetear]] to spawn [[Natasha Whitewater]] nearby - receive [[Oil of Fennin Ro]] ('''Natasha Whitewater will despawn 5 minutes after spawning in Lake Rathetear unless engaged in combat and after turning in the Damaged Goblin Crown.''')
* Kill [[Shmendrik Lavawalker]] to spawn [[A Spirit of Flame]]
:* Loot [[Damaged Goblin Crown]] from [[A Spirit of Flame]] ('''Do not let Natasha Whitewater get the last hit or the corpse will disappear''')

:* Give [[Damaged Goblin Crown]] to [[Natasha Whitewater]] -- receive [[Ornate Sea Shell]] ('''Natasha Whitewater will despawn 5 minutes after spawning in Lake Rathetear unless engaged in combat and after turning in the Damaged Goblin Crown.''')
:* Give [[Ornate Sea Shell]] to [[Omat Vastsea]] in [[Timorous Deep]] -- receive [[Coral Statue of Tarew]]
:* Give the [[Coral Statue of Tarew]] to a [[A Seeker|Seeker]] in [[The Temple of Solusek Ro]] causing them to become [[A Plasmatic Priest]]
:* Kill [[A Plasmatic Priest]] in [[The Temple of Solusek Ro]] and loot [[Blood Soaked Plasmatic Priest Robe]]

:* Give the [[Blood Soaked Plasmatic Priest Robe]] to [[Omat Vastsea]] –- receive [[Orb of Frozen Water]] (This spawns Natasha inside the hut, It is suggested you wait to turn in until you have [[Lord Gimblox's Signet Ring]])
* Loot [[Lord Gimblox's Signet Ring]] from [[Lord Gimblox]] in [[Solusek's Eye]]
:* Give [[Lord Gimblox's Signet Ring]] to [[Natasha Whitewater]] in [[Timorous Deep]] –- receive [[Ornate Sea Shell]](v2) (This despawns Natasha)
:* Give [[Ornate Sea Shell]](v2) to [[Naxot Deepwater]] in [[Burning Woods]] - receive [[Message to Natasha]] (This spawns Ixiblat Fer)
::* Loot [[Sceptre of Ixiblat Fer]] from [[Ixiblat Fer]] in [[Burning Woods]]
:* Give [[Sceptre of Ixiblat Fer]] and [[Singed Scroll]] to [[Omat Vastsea]] -– receive [[Orb of Clear Water]] (This spawns Natasha inside the hut)
* Give [[Message to Natasha]] (Received when spawning Ixiblat Fer) to [[Natasha Whitewater]] in [[Timorous Deep]] –- receive [[Shimmering Pearl*]] (This does not despawn Natasha)

:* Give [[Shimmering Pearl*|Shimmering Pearl]] to [[Zordak Ragefire]] in [[Nagafen's Lair]] -- causes him to repop as [[Zordakalicus Ragefire]] and attack you - kill and loot [[Heart of Zordak Ragefire]]
:* Give [[Heart of Zordak Ragefire]] to [[Omat Vastsea]] – receive Orb of Vapor (Do NOT do this until ready to turn all orbs into Jhassad, as this step spawns Jhassad for the final turn in)
* Give all three orbs (Frozen Water / Clear Water / Vapor) to [[Jhassad Oceanson]] in [[Timorous Deep]] -- receive Orb of Triumvirate (This spawns the [[Avatar of Water]] in the lake)
:* Give Orb of Triumvirate to [[Avatar of Water]] –- receive [[Water Sprinkler of Nem Ankh]]

The quest begins in [[Lake Rathetear]] where you must kill a named water goblin, [[Lord Bergurgle]]. He spawns in the underwater goblin cave, in the tower at (2800, 150). He is around level 40 and casts Complete Heal on himself. He is a rare spawn on a 29 minute spawn timer with a placeholder. The Deepwater Goblins spawn around him so have some companions come along with you, and remember to have [[Enduring Breath]] active. He drops [[Lord Bergurgle's Crown]].

Take the crown to [[Shmendrik Lavawalker]] (3600, 0) who spawns once every 3 hours. Stay at his spawn spot because he is level 30 so someone might kill him if you're not there. When you trade him the crown he will give you {{:Oil of Fennin Ro}} (a potion that's unrelated to the quest) and [[Natasha Whitewater]] will spawn. Natasha will kill Shmendrik, causing [[a spirit of flame]] to immediately spawn on his corpse. Kill this level 40 spirit of flame who has approximately 3300 hitpoints.  Natasha may despawn approximately 5 minutes after she first appears.

Natasha will also try to kill Spirit of Flame so just root, enstill, mesmerize, or do something that will keep her out of the fight (but don't killer her!) because if she gets the killing blow it may cause the corpse to disappear. Loot the [[Damaged Goblin Crown]] from him. Next, give Natasha the Damaged Goblin Crown. Make sure you clear your aggro if you rooted, mezzed, or otherwise took any aggressive action before you attempt to do the trade in. After giving Natasha the Damaged Goblin Crown, she will give you an [[Ornate Sea Shell]].

(An alternate way to do the turn in (but more time consuming) is to first just kill Shmendrik without giving him the Lord Bergurgle's Crown, then kill spirit of the flame and loot the Damaged Goblin Crown. Then wait for Shmendrik to spawn again, give him Lord Bergurgle's Crown, kill the spirit of flame and give Natasha the Damaged Goblin Crown you already have. After giving Natasha the Damaged Goblin Crown, she will give you an Ornate Sea Shell.)

Take the Ornate Sea Shell to [[Omat Vastsea]] in [[Timorous Deep]] (-11567, -2227). To reach him, take the cave entrance at (-11530, -3728), and then the entrance at (-11336, -1307). He will give you a [[Coral Statue of Tarew]]. Take the statue to [[a seeker]] in the [[Temple of Solusek Ro]]. He is on the upper level at (326,38,29) and will spawn at 9 A.M. and despawn at 9 P.M. game time.

When you give a seeker the Coral Statue, he will take it and change into [[a plasmatic priest]] and start attacking you. He hits in the high hundreds and has ~13k hit points. He is level 55 and casts Complete Heal, Tremor, Annul Magic, Reckoning. You should always bring him to the zone before attacking him because his Area Effect Tremor makes the keepers around him attack him, and if they get the kill you will lose the corpse and have to start over. Once you have killed him, loot his [[Blood Soaked Plasmatic Priest Robe]].

Now head to [[Solusek's Eye]] (Solusek A) and kill [[Lord Gimblox]]. He is a rare spawn on a 18 minute spawn timer with a placeholder. He is only level 30 and shouldn't be hard to kill. Loot his [[Lord Gimblox's Signet Ring]]. Now, take the Blood Soaked Plasmatic Priest Robe to Omat Vastsea back in Timorous Deep, who will give you the [[Orb of Frozen Water]] in return and cause Natasha Whitewater to spawn nearby.

Immediately after giving Omat Vastsea the Blood Soaked Plasmatic Priest Robe, run to Natasha Whitewater in a house close to Omat. Give her Lord Gimblox's Signet Ring and she will give you a second Ornate Sea Shell. (She despawns after being handed Lord Gimblox's Signet Ring per the December 1st 2014 patch notes. Nilbog: Natasha Whitewater (Lake Rathe) now depops when given Damaged Goblin Crown. Natasha Whitewater (Timorous) now depops when given Lord Gimblox Ring.)

Take this Sea Shell to [[Naxot Deepwater]] in [[Burning Woods]]. Her location is (3400, -2150). He spawns there at 6 P.M. game time and despawns at 6 A.M. He will give you a [[Message to Natasha]]. Upon handing Naxot Deepwater the Ornate Sea Shell, [[Ixiblat Fer]] will spawn.

Now you must kill Ixiblat Fer. He is an immense level 62 Fire Elemental. Hit hits for up to 575 damage and has over 32000 hit points. He spawns in the Burning Woods at (-2000, 1500). He casts a 300 damage Area Effect fire based spell. His magic resistance is average to below average for his level. He is not completely immune to fire-based spells but it is recommended that you use cold-based and magic. (Ixiblat is considered Summoned which means that the Ward Summoned line of spells will hit for full damage.) Once he's at low health he will try to run. Try and keep him still because he has a fast regeneration rate. Loot off of him the [[Sceptre of Ixiblat Fer]]. This drops every time.

Now you have to kill the [[Overking Bathezid]]. This level 63 sarnak spawns in [[Chardok]] and takes many people to kill. He casts a 500 damage Area Effect spell, Complete Heal, Gravity Flux, and Gate. You have to be careful when killing him. If you fight him at his spawning location you must take caution that you don't aggro the Queen and you also have to be careful that he doesn't cast Gravity Flux, which will aggro more mobs in the upstairs rooms such as the Herbalist. You can also fight him in the hallway but then you must be careful he doesn't Gate, because then he will start summoning people and they will die. Loot a [[Singed Scroll]] off him which drops every time.
Take the Singed Scroll and Sceptre of Ixiblat Fer to Omat Vastsea in Timorous Deep. He will give you the [[Orb of Clear Water]] and Natasha Whitewater will spawn again.

Run straight to Natasha Whitewater after doing the previous step. Give her the Message to Natasha and you will receive a shimmering pearl. Now comes what most players agree to be the most tedious part of the quest, killing [[Zordak Ragefire]] (or rather, waiting for him to spawn in order to kill him).

Once inside [[Nagafen's Lair|Solusek B]], head to the back to Nagafen's Lair. Hand him your shimmering pearl. After being given the shimmering pearl, Zordak Ragefire will attack you. When he is killed, his true (dragon) form, [[Zordakalicus Ragefire]], will spawn on the spot where he dies. Zordakilicus Ragefire is a clone of Lord Nagafen, but will not banish level +53 characters. Normal Nagafen tactics apply.
You will end up with the [[Heart of Zordak Ragefire]]. Take this to Omat Vastsea in Timorous Deep.

Omat Vastsea says 'I see now that Zordak Ragefire and the exiled elder dragon Zordakalicus were the same being. That explains how he resisted our attempts to divine his affairs and past. Each of these orbs I have granted you represents one of the Triumvirate. Jhassad Oceanson awaits on the shore below to perform the ritual that will merge the orbs into a single Orb of the Triumvirate and summon an avatar from the Plane of Water. Present the Orb of the Triumvirate to the Avatar of Water when it arrives and allow your destiny to be unraveled.'

After the last step, [[Jhassad Oceanson]] will spawn close to the shore. Give Jhassad the three orbs: Orb of Frozen Water, Orb of Water, and Orb of Vapor. He will return to you the Orb of Triumvirate, and the Avatar of Water will spawn near Jhassad by the shore. The avatar will then roam around the shore and finally come stand next to Jhassad. It is recommended you wait for the Avatar of Water to stand next to Jhassad because then you will receive experience when you turn in the last Orb, a rather substantial amount due to this being an epic quest. If you give it to him while he is on his roam path, you will not receive experience. Turn in the Orb of Triumvirate to the Avatar of Water. He will give you the [[Water Sprinkler of Nem Ankh]].

The effect is right click-based and is a level 56 cleric spell summoning someone to his/her corpse with a 96% experience regain. Note: you can equip the epic at level 46 but must be level 50 to use the click effect.

: Shmendrik Lavawalker says 'Hail, good [your name here] !! Be wary near the waters of Lake Rathe! The Riptide goblin king, Lord Bergurgle has been commanding his minions to murder and rob all who come near it! I am here seeking his death but I am afraid I am no match for all of his subjects. I shall reward you greatly for the death of Lord Bergurgle. I simply ask that you bring me his crown as proof.'

: Shmendrik Lavawalker shoves the crown into a scorch marked leather satchel and cackles uncontrollably as madness twists his features and flames dance in his eyes. You have reduced the Riptides into chaos! Without a king to keep them in control they will ravage the settlements surrounding this lake! After the slaughter I shall return and easily burn the remainder of the villages and fishing shanties to the ground! None shall escape the fires of the Tyrant!!'
You'll receive Oil of Fennin Ro in exchange for the crown, and will have Natasha Whitewater spawn in a hut nearby.

: Natasha Whitewater says 'The Riptide goblins must have their crown returned to them. If you would be so kind as to give me the crown I will make sure that it reaches them. Hopefully they are capable enough to repair the damage that has been done to it.'

: Natasha Whitewater says 'I will have this crown returned to the Riptide Goblins immediately! Should you ever come across an Erudite named Omat Vastsea, give him this sea shell. The waters of Norrath shimmer with awareness of your deeds here today!'
Receive an Ornate Sea Shell (Item Lore: Ornate Sea Shell I).

: Omat Vastsea bows deeply. 'I have been expecting you. The waters have foretold your arrival. I am High Priest Omat Vastsea of the Triumvirate missionaries. Please feel free to enjoy the quiet solitude of this inn.'
Hand him the Ornate Sea Shell.

: Omat Vastsea says 'So, you are a friend of Natasha's? That is good to see. She is a very wise and gifted woman. The Riptide goblins have adopted a new king but are still in a vulnerable state until his subjects accept his rule. The Plasmatic Priesthood is aware of the weakened state of the Riptides and has convinced the Fire Peak goblins to strike against them. Although I do not agree with the mannerisms or actions of any goblin clan, such a war would be detrimental to all who are caught in its path. Lord Gimblox of the Fire Peak clan has been meeting with a member of the Plasmatic Priesthood in the Temple of Solusek Ro. Locate the Plasmatic Priest, hand him this statue to hinder his powers, then eliminate him and bring me his robe.'
Receive Coral Statue of Tarew Marr.

: A seeker shakes violently as his hand closes on the coral statue and flames dance in the depths of his eyes! The statue begins to emit a reddish glow then shatters in a burst of fire and smoke! The flames in the plasmatic priest's eyes vanish with the explosion and only madness remains! 'The Triumvirate thinks that destroying my spirit of flame will stop me?!! I will kill you all now, the goblins will continue to war, and when my spirit is restored I will ensure that Ixiblat Fer consumes all of Norrath in his flames!!'

: Natasha Whitewater says, 'Thank you for your services thus far. The Triumvirate missionaries are, so far, impressed. p99_evidence_lines.text: There are (on Project 1999) seven Coldain prayer shawls, and each is an upgrade of the previous, with {{:Runed Coldain Prayer Shawl}} being the final reward:

Below is a checklist of all skill levels and non-trivial items that you must acquire for this quest.  Items given by NPCS as part of the quest, items which can be purchased from vendors, or items that can be crafted using items purchased from vendors (eg. [[Mixing Bowl]] or [[Pie Tin]]) are not listed.
* 2x [[Ulthork Meat]]   (don't forget to collect 1x [[Ulthork Tusks]] for Shal 7)
::*[[Mixing Bowl]] (Pottery - Trivial 17; Make: [[Clump of Dough]] x1, [[Spicy Ulthork Meat]] x1, [[Saucy Bunnymeat]] x1, )
::*[[Pot]]  (Pottery - Trivial at 56,  or Blacksmithing - Trivial 122; Easier to go the pottery route)
* 1x [[Small Brick of Velium]] (IMORTANT: pick up 2x. This means 1x for Shawl #4, 1x for Shawl #7)
* 2x [[Small Piece of Velium]] (IMORTANT: pick up 4x. This means 2x for Shawl #4, 2x for Shawl #7)
* 2x [[Drakkel Wolf Whisker]] (Getting at least 4 would be wise, this is often the rarest drop to come by)

* 2x [[Siren Hair]] (Getting at least 4 would be wise, he Sirens are often the most difficult mobs to kill for this shawl and drops are not so common. Also keep an eye out for Sirens to drop [[Runed Sea Shell (Enduring Breath)]] for Shawl 7)
* 1x [[Runed Sea Shell (Enduring Breath)]] (Enduring Breath) (may have dropped when doing Shawl 6 siren kills)
* 1x [[Small Brick of Velium]] (best to have picked up when collecting for Shawl 4)
* 1x [[Ulthork Tusks]] (best to have picked up when collecting Shawl 3 ulthork meat)
* 3x [[Iceclad Cutlassfish ]] (technically obtained from Fishing in and is not a drop)
* 2x [[Small Piece of Velium]] (best to have picked up when collecting for Shawl 4)
'''[[Great Divide]]''' to get XP and drops:
* 2x [[Drakkel Wolf Whisker]] (Shawl 6 and painful to do when not able to get xp, so prioritize these 1st at level 35 and I highly recommend getting at least 4 as these are high fail combines)
'''[[Great Divide]]''' to get XP and drops:
'''[[Eastern Wastes]]''' to get XP and drops:
* 4x [[Snow Griffin Egg]] (Shawl 3 - these will be very tough until about level 50 and soloable at 49 by good Enchanters and Necros)
'''[[Crystal Caverns]]''' to get XP and drops:
* 3x [[Crystalline Silk]] (Shawl 4 - also pick up all the stacks you need for Tailoring trade skilling at this point)
* 2x [[Small Brick of Velium]] (Shawl 4 needs 1x, Shawl 7 needs 1x)
* 4x [[Small Piece of Velium]] (Shawl 4 needs 2x, Shawl 7  needs 2x)
'''[[Velketor's Labyrinth]]''' to get XP and drops:

* 75x [[Crystalline Silk Thread]] (Shawl 5 - IMPORTANT: You can just go there at any level and loot the tons of threads that rot on the floor group's spider's.  Rarely is anyone collecting them.  Just bring a sewing kit with you.)
'''[[Cobalt Scar]]''' to get XP and drops:

* 2x [[Siren Hair]] (Shawl 6 - 49+ Enchanters and Necros can solo the sirens but if in a group, must have Snare/Fear combo or Fear with Pet's combo because pets can keep up with feared and un-snared running/swimming mobs.  They must be feared the entire fight to not charm players or pets or dispell enduring breath or player's charmed mobs.)
* 1x [[Runed Sea Shell (Enduring Breath)]] (Shawl 7 - Easier to just buy from players)
'''[[Siren's Grotto]]''' to get XP and drops:

* 1x [[Molkor Hide]] (Shawl 7 - It is easier to just buy but if killing for it... It is basically mandatory for the group to have 2 charmers (2 Druids or Enchanters or a combo). Group must have an MR debuffer and slower (Shaman or Enchanter). Group needs plenty of stun capability to interrupt Molkor CH and Gates.  This is more of a tactical kill group than an XP group)
* 1x [[Swordfish Tooth]] (Shawl 7 - This is not really a group mob but if there doing Molkors get the Druid or Enchanter to kill the entrance swordfish for tooth drops)
'''[[Kael Drakkal]]''' to get XP and drops:
* 1x [[Royal Kromrif Blood]] (Shawl 7 - Easier to just buy from players who get from raids)
